title: Ijwi ryinjiranye n'imisozi
intro: Umuntu w’umukiranutsi yahawe impano zidasanzwe ziturutse mu ijuru, aba umutegetsi n’intwari ufite kamere isa n’aho ifitanye isano n’ibyaremwe ubwabyo. Inkuru yabo iravanga mu buhanuzi, ubwami, n’ubuhanga, igasiga umurage ugaragara mu mapaji y’ihishurirwa ry’Imana.
clues: Natowe nk'umugaragu wa Allah kandi mpabwa ubwami bukomeye mu bantu batoranijwe.
Imisozi n'inyoni byansubizaga mu gusingiza Usumbabyose.
Icyuma cyaroroshye nk'ibumba mu ntoki zanjye, ku bushake bwa Allah wenyine.
Nakoze intwaro zo kurinda abarwanyi mu gihe cy'intambara.
Igihe kimwe natsinze ikizamini gikomeye ubwo abantu babiri bashyamiranaga binjiraga mu buryo butunguranye mu rusengero rwanjye.
Ndavugwa hamwe n'umutegetsi wategekaga umuyaga n'amajini — kuko uwo mutware yari urubyaro rwanjye.

trial.label: Igeragezwa/Ikibazo
options: Abantu babiri batavuga rumwe binjiye mu cyumba cyanjye cyo gusengeramo
Nahuye n'umwuzure ukomeye washenye ubwoko bwanjye
Abantu banjye bajugunye mu muriro ugurumana
Yageragejwe no gutakaza umuryango wose n'ubutunzi bwose
trial.answer: Abantu babiri batavuga rumwe binjiye mu cyumba cyanjye cyo gusengeramo

location.label: Ikintu cy'ingenzi
options: Icyuma cyakozwe mu ntoki zanjye kugira ngo gikonje
Ubusitani bwiza cyane bufite ubwoko bubiri bw'imbuto
location.answer: Icyuma cyakozwe mu ntoki zanjye kugira ngo gikonje

outcome.label: Ibisubizo
options: Yakiriye Zaburi (Zabur) kandi ashyirwaho nk'umutegetsi utabera
Yarokowe mu nda y'ifi maze abantu bemera
Nasubijwe mu buzima bwiza kandi mpabwa imigisha myinshi
outcome.answer: Yakiriye Zaburi (Zabur) kandi ashyirwaho nk'umutegetsi utabera

arabic: أَنِ ٱعْمَلْ سَـٰبِغَـٰتٍۢ وَقَدِّرْ فِى ٱلسَّرْدِ ۖ وَٱعْمَلُوا۟ صَـٰلِحًا ۖ إِنِّى بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌۭ
verse: [Commanding him], "Make full coats of mail and calculate [precisely] the links, and work [all of you] righteousness. Indeed I, of what you do, am Seeing." (34:11)
